odd hobbies that quietly
turn you into a genius

reading famous letters

read the private letters of writers and scientists. their letters show how great minds really doubted, argued and changed their minds along the way to greatness.

spotting cloud types

learn the names of ten types of cloud and look for them on walks. it trains you to notice, and suddenly the whole sky becomes a book you can actually read.

one lesson a day

i used to only know my own subject. learning one small thing every day about art, history and science changed how i think and how quickly i connect new ideas.
slides.texte_sophia:
one lesson a day

i used to only know my own subject. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, art, history, science, and i connect ideas i never connected before.

slides.texte_overlay:
translating lyrics

translate a song in a language you don't speak. you pick up words, grammar and a little culture at once, and the song becomes so much more meaningful.

memory palaces

picture a familiar room and place things you want to remember in it. this ancient trick is how memory champions remember long lists, and anyone can learn it.
